title: snownico0722/PaperTodo

zh.gap: 缺口不是「只有极客能用」，恰恰相反：它已经足够简单，而它自己的 issue 区里是一群双屏普通用户，抱怨没法把便签挪到另一块屏上。是主流笔记应用集体走去了另一边——账号、同步、工作区——把桌面本身空了出来。

voices.quote: …希望添加右键主胶囊能够有像右键任务托盘中软件图标一样的功能列表， 希望右键胶囊能够添加一个发送到其他屏幕的功能，可以选择发送到不同的显示屏，我有两个屏幕，如果要设置到另一个屏幕有点太麻烦了，希望能便捷一些。，如果不行的话是否能在设置里设置胶囊显示的主屏幕。

zh.pain: 体验 PaperTodo 的极简桌面便签，享受无杂乱工作空间——已有 1,282 个星标！
zh.kill: 这是一个免费小工具，而这个品类三十年来是免费赢：Windows 自带便笺，没有人为一张便利贴付过钱。issue 区的诉求也是没有边界的打磨（分屏摆放、右键菜单、胶囊行为），小工具就是这样悄悄长成大软件、却始终没长成生意。
zh.move: 不卖那张纸，卖纸后来去哪了。桌面便签三十年没做过的一件事是「记得」——三个月前写在一块你已经不用的显示器上的那张，就这么没了。同样安静的纸，加上「这台机器上我写过的所有东西，能搜，永不上传」。冷启动第一步：中文＝小红书「桌面便签 推荐」「电脑便签 不打扰」标签下的评论区；英文＝r/Windows 与 r/productivity 里求「不要账号的便签」的帖子。

gap: The gap is not that only geeks can use it — the opposite. It is already simple, and its tracker is full of ordinary two-monitor users who cannot move a note to the other screen. Every mainstream note app walked the other way, into accounts, sync and workspaces, and left the desk itself empty.
pain: Experience a clutter-free workspace with PaperTodo's minimalist sticky notes—1,282 stars strong!
kill: This is a free utility in a category where free has won for thirty years: Windows ships Sticky Notes, and nobody has ever paid for a sticky note. The tracker's request list is also unbounded polish — per-monitor placement, right-click menus, capsule behaviour — which is how a small tool quietly becomes a large one without ever becoming a business.
move: Do not sell the note; sell what happens to it afterwards. The one thing desktop stickies have never done is remember — a note you scribbled three months ago on a monitor you no longer own is simply gone. Ship the same silent paper plus 'everything I ever scribbled on this machine, searchable, never uploaded'. Cold start (Chinese): 小红书「桌面便签 推荐」「电脑便签 不打扰」标签下的评论区; (English): r/Windows and r/productivity threads asking for a sticky-note app with no account.
demoted_why: pain is a product blurb; the one voice is a feature request (move the sticky to my other monitor), not a pain worth two weeks
